speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the appearance of your longstanding pruritic rash on your palms, and do you have a history of joint pain or mouth ulcers? Also, have you noticed any skin redness on the soles of your feet?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Toxic Oil Syndrome.

The patient's history of working on a rice farm and caring for livestock, combined with a year-long history of itchy rash on the upper body and face along with numbness and tingling in the palms, is highly suggestive of poisoning from contaminated oil. I will need to confirm this with specific serological tests.

REQUEST TEST: Serum_Lipoarabinomannan; REQUEST TEST: Anti-Mitochondrial_Antibody.

REQUEST IMAGES: Photos of the upper body and face rash.
